$comment: Copy to config/products.local.json (ignored by git: it names every app on the account). Products reads GitHub through the signed-in gh, Vercel through the signed-in vercel CLI, and Google Analytics through gcloud's application-default sign-in. Nothing has to be listed: every Vercel project, and every repository with a 'feedback' label, shows up as a product of its own. List a product here only when it spans several Vercel projects or repositories, needs a nicer name, files its feedback in the shared inbox under an app: label, or has a GA4 property whose web stream does not point at its domain (mobile apps). hide takes Vercel project names or repositories to leave off the board.
